items.title: Anthropic整合Claude Chat與Cowork，AI自行決定如何完成任務
items.summary: Anthropic周三（9/16）宣布整合Claude Chat與Cowork，未來使用者不必再選擇一般聊天或Cowork工作模式，只要向Claude提出需求，系統就會自行判斷如何完成任務。新功能將於未來幾周率先開放Pro與Max方案使用。

items.title: Acronis揭露cPanel和Plesk備份外掛漏洞
items.summary: 上週Acronis發布資安公告，指出Acronis Backup plugin for cPanel & WHM一個高風險漏洞遭到積極利用，用戶應儘速更新至1.9.3 HF3與1.9.4版因應，除此之外該公司並未進一步說明細節。

items.title: 因中東戰事受創的AWS巴林與阿聯資料中心，部分資料確認無法復原
items.summary: 9月15日AWS在Health Dashboard更新中公告，今年3月間因中東戰事受創的巴林與阿拉伯聯合大公國AWS基礎設施，其中部分資料與資源已確認無法復原。在巴林方面，巴林me-south-1服務區域（Region）的mes1-az2可用區（Availability Zone，AZ）於3月受損後，便已建議客戶遷移，但稍後另一個AZ於4月受損，導致整個服務區域無法使用。

items.title: Google強化Gemini Enterprise成本管控，新增隨用隨付計費與專案支出上限
items.summary: Google Cloud近期為企業AI平臺Gemini Enterprise新增計費與成本控制方式，除了既有依使用者席次訂閱的方案，也新增隨用隨付（Pay-as-you-go）計費、彈性節省方案，以及專案層級每月支出上限功能，協助企業管理AI代理及相關AI工具的使用成本。

items.title: 思科ISE、Acronis網頁主機管理平臺備份工具漏洞遭積極利用
items.summary: 9月16日美國網路安全與基礎設施安全局（CISA）發布公告，表示他們已掌握兩個漏洞遭到積極利用的證據，這些弱點是：思科身分識別服務引擎（ISE）特權API使用不正確漏洞CVE-2026-76460

items.title: fix(models): retain native model choices during full refresh (#150806)
items.summary: fix(models): retain native model choices during full refresh (#150806) Full catalog refreshes could expose provider results before native discovery and its paired auth facts settled, temporarily dropping native model choices. Keep the previous complete catalog, runtime models, and inventory published until the new generation is complete, and restore the previous publication on acquisition failure. Preserve the five-second foreground bound, scoped provider refreshes, and recorded discovery failures. The worker-boundary regression holds native acquisition to exercise concurrent readers and verifies the final merged catalog. Related: #150427 Validation: forced-ordering regressions reproduced the defect on macOS and Linux, then passed 20/20 serial runs per platform with the fix. Catalog/model-selection suites passed 641 tests across 41 files; build and changed checks passed. Exact-head CI: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/35209693054.

items.title: fix(doctor): preserve channel ownership across updates (#150555)
items.summary: fix(doctor): preserve channel ownership across updates (#150555) Preserve historical channel-account ownership when updates migrate a legacy multi-agent roster to explicit bindings. Carry the original roster through the shared Doctor migration and its update, manual repair, startup, and recovery callers; retain narrower conversation routes. Missing provenance produces actionable warnings without a warning-only config write. Use the Gateway's existing terminal account status for unresolved ownership so correctly bound siblings stay online without repeated retries. Load binding repair lazily during full migration to preserve synchronous recovery and the native wrapper's eager import boundary. Update the migration and Telegram multi-agent documentation. Thanks to @arrobapontocom-ui for the upgrade report. Related: #150452 (item 5), #138014. Validation: the authoring lane reports 734 focused tests and 10 migration E2E tests passing; exact-head CI run 35208329464 is green. The r3 Codex review is scoped-clean. Published-updater ownership/restart proof for the legacy roster fixture and live Telegram transport remain explicit evidence gaps.

items.title: fix(process): release exec child groups when their tool call settles …
items.summary: fix(process): release exec child groups when their tool call settles (#150750) Completed host exec commands could retain shell-backgrounded children and their relay/anchor processes until Gateway restart, exhausting process limits during repeated turns and heartbeats. Release and join the existing supervisor group before reporting completion. Preserve supervised background commands until their root finishes and leave sandbox lifetimes with their backend. Treat EPERM from the process-group disappearance probe as continued presence within the existing cleanup deadline; only ESRCH confirms absence. Persistent groups and unexpected probe failures remain observable. This intentionally stops shell-backgrounded descendants when their root exits; long-running workloads should use the existing supervised background mode. No configuration or migration is required. Validation: the original real exec regression left 15 live PIDs after five completed commands. The repaired implementation passed macOS/Linux stress proof with 100 exec calls per platform and zero survivors, plus isolated Gateway heartbeat/reset proof. The 63 owner/Doctor settlement tests and 12 focused background/sandbox/one-shot tests passed. The reviewed patch is unchanged and exact-head CI run 35208095745 is green. Thanks to @php737, @terrencehinds99, @flowzito, and @michaeljgood71 for the reports and investigation. Related: #142965, #146620, #145092
